issues.description: SealSaloon.checkOrderReady() has conflicting return types: the problem statement/UML specifies `checkOrderReady(): void`, but the solution implements `public boolean checkOrderReady()`. Students following the UML will implement a `void` method and will not match the reference API/signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent by changing the solution signature to `public void checkOrderReady()` (remove the boolean return and `servedAny` return), or update the UML/problem statement to specify a boolean return type.

issues.description: The SealSaloon `stock` field is inconsistent between UML and text: the UML association indicates an instance attribute `stock`, while the written requirements explicitly state `stock` must be `static` and shared across all saloons. This makes it unclear whether students should implement `stock` as instance or static.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML to explicitly mark `stock` as `static` (and final if intended), or adjust the written requirements to match an instance-level `final Stock stock`.

issues.description: Stock exposes a public method `setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[])` in both template and solution, but this method is not present in the problem statement/UML (which only lists add/take/find/addToStockIngredients/emptyStock). This introduces an undocumented public API that bypasses the intended stock-management methods and can mislead students about expected encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Either add `setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[])` to the UML/problem statement as an allowed public method, or remove it/make it non-public and rely on `addToStockIngredients`/`emptyStock` as specified.
